newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon sees higher 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon sees higher 1996 profits.

text.p: German specialty chemicals group SGL Carbon AG is likely to report a further sharp increase in its 1996 profits, management board chairman Robert Koehler told a shareholder value conference on Tuesday.
Koehler said he expected the company's profit to rise to between 300 million and 320 million marks this year from 260 million in 1995.
He said the improvement came despite considerable economic and internal problems at the company.
He said an expected 20 million marks of restructuring costs, sustained in connection with takeovers, had already been factored in to the forecast.
